Goals to Today processes only the information needed to manage annual and quarterly plans as schedules and records. We do not track you for advertising or sell personal information.
Sign-in identifiers, email and display name: account authentication and cross-device synchronization
Goals, tasks, schedules, activity time, reflections and change history: providing the planning features requested by the user
Google Calendar OAuth tokens and event links: calendar synchronization enabled by the user. Tokens are encrypted on the server
Web and app push tokens and notification history: reminders enabled by the user. Tokens are encrypted on the server
Short-lived rate-limit identifiers and error and performance logs: security, incident response and service reliability
